P02.acceptance_append: Library changes are allowed: consume the selected upstream portable subset and exact revision; do not infer ABI semantics from a removed cfg guard.

P03.scope_append: Consume the explicit upstream slim runtime profile, including no-atomic64 semantics and finite thread/job caps.
P03.acceptance_append: Census all threads and allocations before/after first blocking, file, reconnect and cancellation calls. No-thread mode rejects unsupported blocking closures rather than running them inline on the render owner. Bound captured pending-job bytes, not only job count; census between block_on calls as well as startup.

P04.scope_append: Device owner retains pool-slot ownership independent of future/token Drop. Expose minimum submission lead and an irrevocable-until presentation cursor, plus bounded acknowledged flush/stop behavior.
P04.acceptance_append: Forget completion futures/tokens, cancel drains, inject stale completions and try slot reuse. Never reuse storage still accessible by the kernel; quarantine remains bounded. A copying-write ABI may avoid shared-memory leases only with explicit evidence. Include destruction of the lease table/device owner itself; table ownership is insufficient if its Drop frees externally referenced storage.

D02.acceptance_append: Existing stability validation also covers admitted realization/quantization, intermediate ranges and nonzero-state profile switches. Board-lifetime thermal/excursion/protection history survives seek, reconnect and source replacement; source-local histories follow an explicit reset/ramp policy.

D04.acceptance_append: Pre-admit cleanup records and buffer ownership before Running; inject allocator failure during start, cancel, drain and reconnect. Logical capacity rejection is distinct from process/kernel OOM; process-death mute remains external qualification.

N04.scope_append: Compute consume_by from presentation time minus admitted DSP/conversion work, submission lead and uncertainty. Choose real or concealed output exactly once at consumption cutoff.
N04.acceptance_append: Recovery before DAC presentation but after consume_by is late. Synthetic deadline vectors must include positive downstream cost and backpressure.

N05.acceptance_append: All strategies use identical consume_by boundaries and bounded work, not merely DAC deadlines; expired repair must not delay the next block.

N06.acceptance_append: Admit a repair job only if its conservative remaining-work bound fits before consume_by; never insert recovered output after concealment committed.

N03.acceptance_append: Holdover duration is min(buffer coverage, authority validity, clock-uncertainty bound). Inject counter wrap/reset and half-range ambiguity rather than relying on a 24-hour wall-clock run.

G01.scope_append: First profile uses one configured authority per group incarnation; followers never independently mint a higher valid epoch. Network isolation sacrifices new control availability, not authority uniqueness. Automatic replacement requires a separately specified grant/quorum/lease-expiry protocol before enabling it.
G01.acceptance_append: Cutover readiness includes every member's irrevocable old-output tail. Choose qualified drain cutover, acknowledged muted abort/restart, or exclude/abort. Two partitioned followers must not become simultaneous valid leaders. Protection state is not reset with the source epoch. Exclusion or UI removal is not output-stop evidence. Before conflicting output under the same group identity, all prior grant holders, including disconnected/excluded members, must acknowledge stop or pass a bounded output expiry plus irrevocable tail, clock uncertainty and stop/drain lead. Receivers enforce output deadlines including queued samples. Unknown or unenforceable bounds refuse conflicting start. Model assertions cover all prior grant holders, not only current members.

S03.acceptance_append: A successful seek/skip is not acknowledged until old submitted output is drained or qualified flush/mute is acknowledged at the agreed boundary; old ingress rejection alone is insufficient.

T01.acceptance_append: Closing a negative study does not close T04. T04 is provisional development admission; full native qualification is a separate Q06 result after implementation and combined tests.

scope_replace.native admission remains pending until c: provisional development admission belongs to T04; final native qualification remains pending until Q06 evidence

T02.acceptance_append: Start from T04's positive provisional candidate or bounded upstream-adaptation decision. Restrict initial native tailnet exposure to explicit authenticated control services; proxy/gateway identity is not native identity.

X04.title: Implement offline Alexa voice-to-Spotify routing contract
X04.acceptance: Offline supported-mechanism specification, account/group routing adapter and positive/negative directive fixtures pass. If provider admission is unavailable, label the adapter unqualified. This software task never establishes actual voice-to-playback success; X05 owns external proof and remains open until received.

Q04.title: Qualify offline combined native-integration candidate
Q04.scope_append: This is an offline software/guest combined campaign; real provider and physical receipts belong to Q06 and X05.
Q04.acceptance_append: Missing external receipts do not block this offline campaign, but prevent native release eligibility. Distinguish enabled native control-plane residency from simultaneously active audio sources; only one admitted source per group.

Q05.acceptance_append: Release eligibility requires the complete artifact-bound Q06 evidence matrix, including pair/Sub-specific criteria when enabled; software task closure alone cannot advertise native or hardware-qualified capability.

new_tasks.title: Adapt Asupersync upstream for bounded legacy runtime profiles
new_tasks.scope: Own changes in the Asupersync repository: real minimal module/dependency feature gates; semantic replacements for unavailable AtomicU64; explicit worker/blocking/job/stack caps; pre-admitted cleanup records. Keep structured concurrency and cancellation contracts.
new_tasks.acceptance: Stable target feature graphs for BE PPC/MIPS compile or report exact blockers; thread-local u64 is allowed only for local state, shared fallbacks preserve atomic semantics and stay off render deadlines. No silent u32 truncation or naive split-word atomics. Saturation/allocator-failure/cancel/drain tests plus guest receipts required; cfg metadata is not runtime proof.

new_tasks.title: Extract and adapt portable Franken support-library subsets
new_tasks.scope: Own selected upstream franken_kernel/frankenlibc/frankenfs/franken_remote adaptations. Publish pinned feature and unsafe/FFI inventory; factor alloc/std/host-only dependencies; port only selected platform primitives or use semantic references behind a small adapter, without importing full desktop/filesystem stacks.
new_tasks.acceptance: Each selected primitive has BE layout, errno, time-width, syscall/TLS and target tests as applicable. Removing an architecture compile_error alone is not a port. Resolve differing Asupersync pins explicitly. Portable parsers/settings algorithms may be extracted without claiming raw-flash/filesystem support; LocalAPI delegation is not native Tailscale.

new_tasks.title: Admit a native tailnet development candidate per target profile
new_tasks.scope: Machine-readable positive provisional development decision keyed by exact target, candidate revision and adaptation strategy. Separate source availability, offline feasibility and final native interoperability. A bounded owner-authorized upstream implementation may be the selected strategy.
new_tasks.acceptance: Negative T01 leaves this gate open and T02 blocked. Positive decision names required native identity/control/data-plane behavior, unresolved limits and next discriminators; it does not assert final resource fit or interoperability. Graph fixture verifies negative study closure cannot clear this independent gate.

new_tasks.title: Validate externally supplied Alexa music-routing qualification evidence
new_tasks.scope: Consume authorized external receipts for supported provider admission and utterance-to-selected-group playback. No enrollment, voice request or device command is executed from this repository. Validate receipt identities and feature scope.
new_tasks.acceptance: Remain open when receipts or supported provider mechanism are absent. Offline fixtures and volume/mute success cannot close this gate. Positive/negative/revocation/source-change outcomes and exact software/profile identity required; reject stale or unrelated artifacts.

new_tasks.title: Validate external native-service and physical qualification gates
new_tasks.scope: Validate imported owner-authorized provider/hardware evidence against exact build/profile capability ledger: Spotify, native AirPlay2/Tailscale, Alexa, source-specific video, line-in and mixed-generation audio. Record candidate, offline, combined, provider and physical levels independently.
new_tasks.acceptance: Remain open until every required capability in the frozen owner-approved profile, independent of implementation enable flags has matching receipts; no device/provider execution here. Stereo/Sub roles need their own phase/polarity/crossover/delay criterion and evidence, not the room skew band. Stale code/profile/calibration invalidates affected evidence. Optional unsupported features are explicit; no silent native-to-assisted substitution. Disabling an unimplemented required feature cannot remove it from the required set; only explicitly optional features can be absent without blocking.
